text:
marta: Deploybot scheduled v2 split-route for 40% at 21:00 UTC. Prep checklist: pinlist, release-notes updated, SDK note. thoughts?

deploy-bot: @marta preflight checks passed (model variants ok). Run `/deploy preflight` to confirm. :white_check_mark:

anne: I'm worried about the mobile SDK header behavior we saw in e2e — casefold vs strict. If we normalize headers at gateway, some clients may break. Recommend hold mobile tenants behind pin.

raj: Agree. Observed ~0.6% request mismatches in canary due to `Version-Signal` header case. Prefer deploy with compatibility shim rather than force change.

tess: SDK team can ship a compatibility toggle but not until tomorrow morning PST. Suggest we pin mobile SDK cohorts to v1 for the first wave.

marta: OK. Plan: proceed with split-route for web (40%), hold mobile and large-emit tenants. ops, can you add pins?

ops-d: Will add pins. Which tenants? list please.

anne: Add tenants: acme_mobile, zoomlite, partner-infra. Also, add rule to fallback to v1 if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency regresses > 20% vs baseline. I'll update release notes.

ops-d: Adding pins now... `deploybot pin add tenant acme_mobile --route=v1`

deploy-bot: Pin added: acme_mobile -> v1; zoomlite -> v1; partner-infra -> v1. Canary window still set for 40% web. Use `/deploybot promote` when ready. :robot_face:

tess: For transparency, I'll add the SDK toggle doc to release notes: "If you see header mismatch, enable SDK flag X-Compat-Header=true".

marta: Also adding operator handoff: if rollout triggers fallback, ops escalate to #incidents and we rollback clients in 15m if threshold persists. :warning:

kevin: Small nit — update changelog with exact header key: `Version-Signal` case-insensitive. Avoid saying "headers" generically.

anne: Deploy command when ready: `/deploybot promote v2 --shard=40 --exclude=acme_mobile,zoomlite,partner-infra --note='web-only split-route; mobile pinned'`

deploy-bot: Scheduled promote for 21:00 UTC. ETA ~10m. Reminders: telemetry hooks active; rollforward window 90m.

marta: Good. Eyes on latency and 5xx. I'll circulate release-note blurb to customers flagged as impacted. :thumbsup:

ops-d: Watching dashboards. If p95 > baseline*1.2 for 3 consecutive 1m bins, we trigger automatic rollback and notify.

anne: Also, confirm SDK team will be oncall tomorrow morning for followups.

tess: Yup. I'll be oncall 06:00-12:00 PST. Will also release the SDK toggle PR at 08:00 PST.

marta: Done, thanks team. Closing out thread. We'll verify post-deploy telemetry and tag the release-note PR.
